Earnings Disclaimer

No guarantee of income

LendTrack does not guarantee that you will earn any money through the partner program. Any earnings or income figures on this Site, including example deals, average commission figures and the earnings calculator, are illustrations only. They are not a promise or guarantee of future earnings.

Results vary

Your results depend on many factors, including your effort, your network, your skills, market conditions, lender approval decisions and the quality of the leads you refer. Many referrals do not result in funded deals. Commissions are paid only on deals that fund, under the terms of a signed Referral Partnership Agreement.

Results shown are not typical

Funded deal amounts and results shown on this Site are individual examples. They are not typical, not averages and should not be relied on as a prediction of your results.

Average share figures

Where we state that partners earn $1,000 to $2,000 per funded deal on average, this refers to the partner share on deals that fund. It does not account for referrals that do not fund, and it is not an estimate of what any individual partner will earn.

Business risk

Business lending involves risk for business owners, and any business activity involves risk for you. Make decisions based on your own judgment and, where appropriate, advice from your own legal, tax and financial professionals.
